system.name: LLM-HAS
system.one_liner: Survey of LLM-based human-agent systems, where humans give information, feedback or control to LLM agents, organised into five core components.

content.variant_note: an illustrated kitchen dialogue at the centre with four pastel dimension boxes around it, each listing options as icon rows
content.argues: A human-agent system is defined by five design components, and each can be configured in a few named ways, from feedback type to communication mode.
content.subject: A household human-robot dialogue at the centre and the option lists for feedback, interaction, orchestration and communication around it.

The system title runs along the bottom.

lessons.what_to_learn: Put one illustrated scenario at the centre as the hub, here a dialogue between human and agents in a concrete setting, and hang the taxonomy dimensions around it as pastel boxes, each an icon row with a bold sub-label and italic option names. Lettering the central component's name on the floor of the scene ties the story to the taxonomy.
lessons.suits: Survey or framework overviews whose design dimensions can be listed as options and whose core idea, an interaction, can be shown as one everyday scene.

evidence: Figure 1 provides a generalized overview of LLM-based human-agent systems.
Human Feedback can occur during different phases in various types and granularities.
The system is composed of five core components: Environment & Profiling

summary: This survey figure gives an overview of LLM-based human-agent systems (LLM-HAS), where humans feed information, feedback or control into an LLM agent. An isometric kitchen scene sits at the centre with three speech bubbles in which a humanoid robot, a cleaning robot and a woman settle when cleaning should start, with tinted spans in the dialogue. The floor of the scene carries the label Environment & Profiling. Around it four rounded pastel boxes list the other core components as icon rows with bold sub-labels and italic options: Human Feedback (type, granularity, phase), Interaction Type, Orchestration Paradigm (task strategy, temporal synchronization) and Communication (structure, mode). The title is lettered along the bottom.
summary_zh: 综述图概览LLM人机协作系统（LLM-HAS）：中央是等距视角的厨房场景和三个对话气泡，地板上写着环境与角色设定；四周四个彩色圆角框分别列出人类反馈、交互类型、编排范式和通信的子维度与选项图标。
notes: Prior kinds reordered to scope-overview first (hub-and-spoke), contribution-mosaic kept last because the boxes map to survey components. The centre scene is counted as the fifth panel because the caption lists Environment & Profiling as the fifth component. Dialogue order and speakers are read from the bubble tails and emoji tags; the mapping of tinted spans to dimension boxes is not stated. Counts of repeated robot and person figures are approximate. The kitchen scene and the 3D figures look illustrated or generated, but their origin cannot be confirmed.
